comment: What each place asks for. A brand's settings list the places it is seen ("rollout"), and the rollout step makes these files for each one. Sizes are the ones in common use when this was written: check each in the platform's own upload dialog. A brand can add places of its own, or change one, under "platforms" in brand.json. In a file name and in the words, {handle} is the account's handle, {at} is the handle with an @ before it and {brand} is the brand's name. An item is one of: "svg" (a logo file drawn at a width), "banner" (the lockup in the middle of the mark's outline, at most "lock" pixels wide), "picture" (logo files placed on a surface), "text" (a file written as text) or "ico" (pictures gathered into one .ico file).
